purpose: Explicitly post-hoc regression on the previously failed fork and sparse-history tasks, after fresh GeoMem grid gate passed. Not independent validation or selection on these queries.

conditions.new_fits: projected stationary target only; reuse projected_batch without changes
conditions.reference: six previously completed unprojected stationary original-head fits; do not rerun or overwrite

data: Reuse exact six original 4096-transition factual reward-free replay files; no new data or oracle targets
matching: Same config, source classes, seeds, RNG consumption and masks as stationary_readout.fit_stationary; archive actual initial weights and sampled row/mask hashes for new fits. Old initial/batch equality is code-and-seed reconstruction unless independently archived, not a measured historical hash.
evaluation: Frozen final weights; every 42 fork or four sparse noninitial queries; initial-goal cases separate; exact same starts, memory/goal ablations, cyclic command and all competing FIRST; saved-weight replay verification
gate: All six new fits must pass every noninitial query; three grid passes alone do not qualify the memory-dependent design. Report every failure with no tuning, rerun or extra fit.
diagnostics: Fresh full factual-replay residuals, raw and target ranges, all initial-goal masks and label counts, per-goal success, shortest arrivals, all competing FIRST, compute, immutable source/data/checkpoint hashes
authorization_boundary: Local graph and tensor work only. No DMLab execution or installation locally; no native submission. Root reviews results before any native candidate preparation.
